messages:
deploy-bot: Commencing staged rollout v2.4.0 -> 3% canary (rollout_id=rollout_3300205555). Change window: 2026-03-22 04:00-05:00 UTC. Auto-checks: perf/err/trace every 4m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.4.0.

rhea: Quick heads-up 3:04 UTC: eu-central showing a small but sustained p50->p95 latency divergence on /embeddings. Not huge, but consistent across 3 probes.

omar: Can you share the probe traces?

rhea: linked: https://short.link/probes/330020. Excerpt suggests repeated requeues in the request router due to slow KV lookups. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-22T04:06:12Z router-euc-4: req=req-42 requeued after 2s wait (kv_lookup=1.9s)
2026-03-22T04:06:13Z canary-pod-5: kv_get miss, falling back to model fetch
```

toni: Sounds like cache jitter. Options: 1) pause auto-advance (hold rollout) and split eu-central back to stable, 2) reduce global canary to 1% and add extra KV metrics, 3) do a localized restart of canary pods in eu-central. Thoughts?

omar: Prefer split + hold. Restarting might mask an underlying regression. If we split eu-central to stable and hold, other regions can continue collecting data. @oncall-sre?

oncall-sre: I'll enact a region override for eu-central -> v2.3.9 and set rollout state to HELD to prevent auto-progress. Will also mark increased sampling for NA/EU canaries. ETA ~5m.

ops-bot: Runbook commands: 
```
# region pin
rolloutctl region-pin --id rollout_3300205555 --region eu-central --target v2.3.9
# hold rollout
rolloutctl hold --id rollout_3300205555
# lower global canary (optional)
rolloutctl set-traffic --id rollout_3300205555 --global-canary 1%
# increase sampling for canary traces
monitorctl sampling set --rollout rollout_3300205555 --sample-rate 15%
```

deploy-bot: Actions applied: eu-central -> v2.3.9 (100% eu-central), rollout set to HELD, global canary lowered to 1%. Links: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/rollout_3300205555

rhea: After pin, eu-central p95 dropped back to baseline. Remaining telemetry (NA, AP) steady. I'll leave enhanced tracing on for 20m and post a follow-up.

omar: I'll open a blocker ticket to investigate KV path latency under canary config; will include heap profiles and kernel stats.

toni: Adding a short entry to release notes about conservative KV limits in canary and the rollback criteria we used. Reactions: :thumbsup: from rhea, omar, toni.

oncall-sre: Incident classification: minor. Next steps: postmortem if we see recurrence after redeploy. Keeping thread pinned for coordination.
